books.title: The Law of Success in Sixteen Lessons
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: Hill's monumental first work, distilled from twenty years of interviews with the titans of his age. Across sixteen lessons it lays the whole foundation — definite purpose, the Master Mind, self-confidence — on which every later book was built. To read it is to watch a philosophy of achievement being assembled stone by stone.

books.title: The Magic Ladder to Success
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: A compact, urgent condensation of the Law of Success philosophy, written as the Depression closed in. Hill strips his teaching to its rungs and invites the reader to begin climbing at once. Long out of print, it is the missing bridge between his early system and Think and Grow Rich.

books.title: Think and Grow Rich
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: The book that made desire a discipline and thought a form of capital. Hill's thirteen principles — from burning desire to the mysterious "sixth sense" — have guided readers for nearly a century and remain among the most influential pages ever written on the inner life of success. Few works have so thoroughly convinced so many that the mind is the first place wealth is made.

books.title: How to Sell Your Way Through Life
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: Hill's argument that every life is an act of persuasion, and that mastering "master salesmanship" is really mastering oneself. Written at the height of his powers, it treats selling as a spiritual practice in sincerity, service and self-belief. A warm, practical companion volume to Think and Grow Rich.

books.title: The Master Key to Riches
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: Here Hill broadens "riches" far past money, into peace of mind, sound health and the labour of love. Built around twelve great riches and the habit of going the extra mile, it is his most explicitly generous book. Many readers find it the gentlest and most spiritually satisfying door into his work.

books.title: How to Raise Your Own Salary
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: Cast as a long dialogue between Hill and Andrew Carnegie, this book lets the reader eavesdrop on the conversation that started everything. Carnegie questions, challenges and instructs, and the seventeen principles emerge in his own voice. It remains the most intimate record of the partnership behind Hill's philosophy.

books.title: Success Through a Positive Mental Attitude
books.author: Napoleon Hill, W. Clement Stone
books.description: Hill's late collaboration with insurance magnate W. Clement Stone, and the book that gave the world the phrase "positive mental attitude". It pairs Hill's philosophy with Stone's hard-won commercial proof, insisting that attitude is a choice made daily rather than a temperament received at birth. Buoyant, practical and enormously influential across the whole self-help tradition.

books.title: Grow Rich! With Peace of Mind
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: Written in Hill's eighties, this is the reflective summing-up of a long life spent studying achievement. He turns from acquisition toward serenity, arguing that riches without tranquillity are a poor bargain. Tender and unexpectedly personal, it reads like a letter from a man who has finally worked out what the money was for.

books.title: Succeed and Grow Rich Through Persuasion
books.author: Napoleon Hill, E. Harold Keown
books.description: Hill's final book published in his lifetime, devoted to the art of moving others without manipulating them. He frames persuasion as an outgrowth of character — you convince people by first becoming convincing. A fitting last word from a man whose whole career was an exercise in changing minds.

books.title: You Can Work Your Own Miracles
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: Published the year after Hill's death, this is his most openly mystical work, concerned with the conditioning of mind that makes the apparently miraculous ordinary. He gathers stories of transformation and draws from them a repeatable inner method. A bridge between practical achievement and frank spiritual conviction.

books.title: Think Your Way to Wealth
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: The full record of Hill's foundational encounter with Andrew Carnegie, in which all seventeen principles are laid out as Carnegie first described them. It is the philosophy at its source, before decades of refinement. A rare chance to hear the idea arriving rather than the finished doctrine.

books.title: Napoleon Hill's A Year of Growing Rich: 52 Steps to Achieving Life's Rewards
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: Fifty-two short chapters drawn from Hill's Success Unlimited magazine, arranged as a week-by-week companion for a whole year. Each is a small, self-contained encouragement on wealth, health, happiness and power. An ideal devotional entry point for readers who prefer their wisdom in daily doses.

books.title: Napoleon Hill's Keys to Success: The 17 Principles of Personal Achievement
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: The clearest single-volume statement of the full seventeen-principle system, assembled posthumously from Hill's own writings. Where Think and Grow Rich inspires, this book organises — each principle given its own chapter, definition and application. Widely regarded as the best modern map of the entire philosophy.

books.title: Selling You! A Practical Guide to Achieving the Most by Becoming Your Best
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: The fullest compilation of Hill's writing on salesmanship, personal services and the quiet business of selling oneself to oneself. Drawn together by the Napoleon Hill Foundation from scattered course material and articles. Practical, encouraging, and rooted in self-respect rather than technique.

books.title: Napoleon Hill's Golden Rules: The Lost Writings
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: A recovered collection of Hill's editorials from his own Golden Rule magazine, written between 1919 and 1923 — years before his fame. Here the philosophy is raw, idealistic and unmistakably spiritual, preoccupied with the Golden Rule as a working law of life. A revelatory look at the young reformer beneath the later success teacher.

books.title: Outwitting the Devil: The Secret to Freedom and Success
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: Hill's most daring and most suppressed work: a staged interrogation of the Devil himself, who confesses how he captures human minds through fear, drifting and procrastination. Considered too provocative to publish, it stayed locked away for over seventy years before Sharon Lechter brought it to light. Strange, bracing and unforgettable — the shadow side of Think and Grow Rich.

books.title: How to Own Your Own Mind
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: Three unpublished Hill lectures from 1941, rescued from a vault and edited by Mitch Horowitz. They concern creative vision, organised thought and controlled attention — the machinery behind every other principle he taught. Hill's insistence that only applied knowledge is power has rarely been argued so precisely.

books.title: The Path to Personal Power
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: Another volume of the Mental Dynamite series, restoring Hill's lost lessons on the disciplined accumulation of personal power. He treats power not as dominance but as capacity — the steady result of definite aim, alliance and self-command. A rigorous, clarifying read for anyone already grounded in the basics.

books.title: Truthful Living: The First Writings of Napoleon Hill
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: Hill's earliest surviving lecture notes, written around 1917 and annotated here by Jeffrey Gitomer. They show a young teacher working out, in real time, the ideas that would become the Law of Success. Intimate and unpolished, it is the closest thing we have to the seed of the whole tradition.

books.title: Success Habits: Proven Principles for Greater Wealth, Health, and Happiness
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: Assembled from a series of radio talks Hill gave late in life, in which he speaks directly and conversationally to an ordinary audience. The tone is plainer than his books and all the warmer for it. A generous, accessible summary of a lifetime's teaching on wealth, health and contentment.

books.title: Andrew Carnegie's Mental Dynamite: How to Unlock the Awesome Power of You
books.author: Napoleon Hill
books.description: Previously unpublished Carnegie–Hill material centred on self-discipline, learning from defeat and the Golden Rule. Released by the Napoleon Hill Foundation with commentary by James Whittaker and Don Green. A late, substantial addition to the canon that deepens rather than merely repeats it.

courses.title: Napoleon Hill® Online Distance Learning Class
courses.description: Step 2 of the Foundation's three-step certification path, run by the Napoleon Hill Academy. Covers the 17 Principles of Success through online readings, chapter quizzes, vintage audio and newly released video, with personalised instruction from accredited instructors. Culminates in an individualised success plan.

courses.title: Napoleon Hill® Leader Certification Course
courses.description: Step 3 of the certification path, conferring Napoleon Hill Certified Leader status. A three-to-four-day intensive delivered online by live video conferencing alongside prerecorded content, so students anywhere can attend without travelling. Tuition includes all digital materials and recordings of every live session.

courses.title: Leader Certification Bundle
courses.description: Steps 2 and 3 purchased together at a USD 249 saving against buying separately. Buyers are not tied to a fixed certification date and may move between events. Step 1 is still bought separately.

courses.title: Your Way To Wealth: The First Step to Becoming A Napoleon Hill Leader
courses.description: The Foundation's designated Step 1 home-study system, delivered as a digital download: eight audio modules running nearly eight hours, plus four instructional videos of Hill himself — over thirteen hours in all. Bonuses include the Think and Grow Rich Discovery Guide workbook, the four-part Master Key To Success series and self-scoring online tests.

courses.title: Napoleon Hill's Master Key (The Master Key to Success) [DVD]
courses.description: The restored 1954 television series featuring Napoleon Hill and W. Clement Stone — thirteen original episodes, plus a 25-minute Cosmic Habit Force lecture and a 31-minute PMA presentation. Includes a 28-page booklet on the 17 Principles. Region-free with English, French and Spanish subtitles.

courses.title: Success Movie App [iPad, iPhone]
courses.description: The Foundation's first official app. Users build personal motivational "success movies" from photographs, messages and music across seven life areas — physical, spiritual, financial, family, vocational, mental and social — then replay them as a visualisation practice reinforcing desire, faith, auto-suggestion and persistence.

courses.title: Napoleon Hill AI™
courses.description: A conversational digital mentor trained on Hill's published works, personal manuscripts and rare audio recordings, offering text and voice dialogue for goal-setting against the 17 Principles. Hosted on Delphi and reached from the Foundation's landing page.

free_resources.title: Self-Confidence Formula by Napoleon Hill (printable PDF)
free_resources.description: Hill's Self-Confidence Formula as a one-page printable, given away free by the Foundation. It is a daily spoken affirmation practice — five commitments repeated aloud until belief hardens into habit. Print it, pin it, say it every morning.

free_resources.title: Hill's Self-Confidence Formula — A Free Printable Reminder
free_resources.description: The Foundation's landing page for the printable above, framing the formula around Carnegie's insistence that confidence begins with definiteness of purpose. A short, warm introduction for anyone meeting the practice for the first time.

free_resources.title: Thought for the Day (full archive)
free_resources.description: The Foundation's daily inspirational entries, each a short Hill quote with a brief commentary, kept as a free paginated archive going back years. This is the same content the Foundation emails daily, readable in full without ever subscribing. An ideal daily-practice feed.

free_resources.title: Pensamiento del día (Spanish daily archive)
free_resources.description: The Spanish-language counterpart to Thought for the Day, paginated and chronological, pairing a Hill quote with a short explanatory passage. The only non-English free daily content on the official site.

free_resources.title: Napoleon Hill Yesterday and Today (weekly ezine archive)
free_resources.description: The Foundation's weekly ezine, archived free and running past issue 959, each with date, author and full text. Contributors expand on a single principle at a time, often with archival stories from Hill's own life. Reading the archive requires no subscription.

free_resources.title: Ezine 958 — Self-Discipline (representative full issue)
free_resources.description: A complete free issue by Executive Director Don Green with Christopher Lake, built around self-discipline, including Hill's 1957 Salem University graduation address and the Milo C. Jones story. Proof that individual issues are readable at stable URLs.

free_resources.title: Essay On Life
free_resources.description: The complete free text of Hill's short philosophical essay, in which Life is personified as an adversary trying to subdue him through love, money, betrayal and the fear of death. Brief, strange and unexpectedly moving — the most openly spiritual short piece the estate publishes.

free_resources.title: Napoleon Hill Timeline
free_resources.description: The estate's chronology of Hill's life from 1883 to 1991, covering the 1908 Carnegie meeting, the 1919–23 magazines, Think and Grow Rich in 1937, the Roosevelt advisory years and the Stone partnership. The nearest thing the Foundation publishes to a free digitised biographical archive.

free_resources.title: Napoleon Hill — Official Biography
free_resources.description: The estate's own account of Hill's life, from the one-room cabin on the Pound River in Wise County to a career that reshaped how the modern world thinks about achievement. The hub page linking the Carnegie, Stone and Essay on Life material.

free_resources.title: Andrew Carnegie (Foundation biography)
free_resources.description: The Foundation's biography of the man who set Hill his life's assignment — Carnegie's rise from immigrant labour to steel, and the service ethic Hill built his philosophy upon. Notes his lifetime giving of over $350 million.

free_resources.title: W. Clement Stone (Foundation biography)
free_resources.description: The life of Hill's great collaborator, who built Combined Insurance from $100, co-authored Success Through a Positive Mental Attitude and later chaired the Foundation. Covers his $275 million in philanthropy.

free_resources.title: Rich or Penniless?
free_resources.description: The estate's short answer to the persistent rumour that Hill died broke, stating that he had endowed his foundation and was living his own philosophy to the end. Includes his death date of 8 November 1970, aged 87.

free_resources.title: Think and Grow Rich Summary (full PDF)
free_resources.description: Sound Wisdom's free abridged edition walking through all thirteen principles from Desire to The Sixth Sense. It includes real exercises — writing a specific financial goal, daily affirmations, and twenty-eight reflective self-assessment questions. The best free introduction to Hill's core work anywhere.

free_resources.title: Self-Confidence Formula: Your Guide to Self-Reliance and Success (full PDF)
free_resources.description: A free five-part guide from the official publisher: defining self-confidence, building power through mastermind relationships, conditioning the mind by autosuggestion, acting against fear, and instilling confidence in the young. Substantially richer than the one-page printable.

free_resources.title: Think and Grow Rich Summary (web version)
free_resources.description: The complete thirteen-principle summary readable in the browser, with no download, payment or signup. A fast, mobile-friendly orientation for readers who aren't ready to commit to the book.

free_resources.title: Napoleon Hill's Greatest Speeches (free preview PDF)
free_resources.description: A free preview of previously unpublished Hill speeches delivered between 1917 and 1957, each set in its historical context. The closest thing to free digitised primary archive material anywhere in the official ecosystem — Hill in his own voice, at full length.

free_resources.title: Napoleon Hill's Greatest Speeches — audio sample (MP3)
free_resources.description: A free downloadable audio sample from the Greatest Speeches collection, hosted by the official publisher. Given how little Hill video the estate publishes, listening remains the most direct way to meet him.

free_resources.title: Napoleon Hill's Power of Positive Action (free preview PDF)
free_resources.description: A free preview of the 2016 Foundation title — fifty chapters by Hill with commentary by Judith Williamson, structured as one chapter per week. It opens on the theme that what you think about, you bring about.

free_resources.title: Napoleon Hill's Gold Standard (free preview PDF)
free_resources.description: A free preview of the 2016 compilation drawing on Hill's essays, books and the PMA Science of Success course, arranged as fifty-two weekly chapters across the 17 Principles, with commentary by Judith Williamson. Built for a year of steady practice.

free_resources.title: Napoleon Hill's Keys to Personal Achievement (free sample PDF)
free_resources.description: An official Foundation publication from 2015, Hill with Judith Williamson, in fifty-two weekly essays. The free sample carries three complete chapters — TIME, with its "Commitment to Doctor Time" resolution, PAIN and THOUGHT.
